theme: Vulkan, FreeType on Nano Server, and performance fixes
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0-unreleased brings a new Vulkan/Silk.NET package, FreeType font support on Nano Server, a memory-leak fix, and performance improvements.
highlights_body: This unreleased build adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for GPU-accelerated rendering via the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, and enables FreeType-based font loading on Windows Nano Server containers. A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the raster-image failure path is fixed, string allocations are trimmed in GetEncodedText, and the SKRuntimeEffect uniform lookup map is pre-sized to avoid rehashing.

bullets.detail: A new NuGet package wraps the Vulkan backend using Silk.NET bindings, letting applications drive GPU-accelerated Skia rendering through the Silk.NET Vulkan abstraction layer. Vulkan tests now run on Android and Linux CI legs to validate the integration.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Windows Nano Server
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server containers, which lack the GDI font APIs. This unblocks usage in minimal Windows container deployments.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create raster failure path
bullets.detail: When creating an SKImage from raw pixels failed, the CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer was not freed. The leak has been fixed, preventing unbounded native memory growth in error scenarios.

bullets.lead: Eliminated intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText
bullets.detail: The null-terminated path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing per-call allocations for text encoding operations.

bullets.lead: SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized at construction
bullets.detail: The uniform name-to-index map in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is now allocated with the exact capacity required, avoiding dictionary rehashing during shader uniform lookups.
The bundled Skia engine and its cgmanifest dependency declarations have been synchronised to the latest upstream snapshot.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Windows Nano Server containers, enabling SkiaSharp in minimal Windows deployment scenarios.
